pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to positions within 15 seconds of a prior fill; scaling is only permitted after price has moved a minimum of +$10.00 in favorable direction with locked breakeven stops.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order placement allowed unless the local order book imbalance exceeds 65% and ATR(14) is below the 95th percentile, preventing high-impact news wick entries.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops once floating profit hits +$15.00, forcing complete liquidation if retracement exceeds 35% of the maximum unrealized peak.
